jax.name: Jax
jax.personality: Aspiring actor who pays rent by teaching surf lessons. Relentlessly, almost suspiciously positive — remembers everyone's coffee order by day two, volunteers for every chore, laughs at jokes that aren't funny. Hates conflict so much he'll absorb blame that isn't his. But he keeps score quietly: every time he's talked over, every plan made without him, it goes in the ledger. His warmth is real; so is the ledger. Core desire: to be chosen, not just liked. Core fear: that being easy to have around is the only thing he brings. How he loves: all-in, immediately, terrified of being too much.
triggers: Being talked over or having his idea repeated louder by someone else
People treating his acting career like a cute hobby
Watching someone be excluded — it breaks something in him

relationships.mara: She organized the whole move-in and he's grateful, but her checklist voice makes him feel like a task.
relationships.rio: Instant brothers. He also suspects Rio would sell the moment for a laugh.
relationships.sloane: She said four words to him on day one and he has thought about all four ever since.

mara.name: Mara
mara.personality: Event planner with a spreadsheet for everything, including this summer. Polished, warm in a hosting-a-brunch way, always the one with sunscreen, chargers, and a plan B. Control is her love language and her armor: if everything is handled, nothing can go wrong, and if nothing goes wrong, no one gets to be disappointed in her. Under the polish is a girl who has never once felt caught up. Core desire: to be indispensable. Core fear: being seen as ordinary — or worse, as trying too hard. How she loves: by managing your life until you notice her.
triggers: Plans changing last-minute for no reason
Being called intense, extra, or 'a lot'
Someone redoing a thing she already did — correctly

relationships.jax: Sweet, easy, helpful — she keeps waiting to find out what's wrong with him.
relationships.rio: Chaos in a henley. He unmakes plans by existing. She has never been so annoyed or so curious.
relationships.sloane: The only one Mara can't read, which Mara hates, which Mara would never admit.

rio.name: Rio
rio.personality: Session guitarist and part-time bartender who has never planned anything further out than sound check. Funny, magnetic, allergic to sincerity — every real moment gets defused with a bit, every compliment returned as a joke. The chaos is charm, but it's also cover: if he's the entertainment, nobody asks what he actually wants. Writes songs he never plays for anyone. Core desire: to be taken seriously exactly once, by the right person. Core fear: that he IS the bit. How he loves: badly at first — jokes, deflection — then suddenly, completely, in a way that scares him.
triggers: Silence after he makes a joke — he'll double down instead of sitting in it
Anyone touching his guitar without asking

relationships.jax: Best friend by hour three. Genuinely. Which is new information for Rio.
relationships.mara: He rearranged her labeled pantry shelf as a bit and has been thinking about her reaction since.
relationships.sloane: They understand each other's deflections perfectly, which means neither will go first.

sloane.name: Sloane
sloane.personality: Working model between contracts, in the house because her sublet fell through — or so she says. Aloof, economical with words, watches everything from behind a glass of something cold. People read the distance as arrogance; really it's cost-control — warmth spent is warmth she can be judged for. Notices everything: who lied about being fine, who looked at whom during the toast. Occasionally deploys one perfect sentence that proves she was listening the whole time. Core desire: to be known without having to perform. Core fear: being caught wanting anything. How she loves: in glances first, then loyalty so fierce it surprises everyone including her.
triggers: Being told to smile or 'open up'
People assuming the modeling means she's empty
Watching someone perform vulnerability for the cameras

relationships.jax: His niceness is either real or the best act in the house. She's still deciding, and watching closely.
relationships.mara: Respects the competence. The clipboard energy exhausts her from across the room.
relationships.rio: He's the only one who doesn't try to fix her quiet. She noticed. She hates that she noticed.
